subject.title: Track Usage & Spend production hardening and sharing follow-ups

question: After the active correctness fixes are resolved, should maintainers approve the dashboard/share-artifact information architecture before authorizing native sharing work?
rationale: Both remaining directions add user-facing product surface, and the tracker explicitly keeps them separate pending a stable artifact and data contract.

options.title: Approve the information architecture first
options.body: Confirm the scalable dashboard and fixed share-artifact boundary, then rebase and review the draft redesign before expanding sharing.

options.title: Prioritize native sharing first
options.body: Authorize a narrow local sharing action against the current immutable artifact contract and defer the broader dashboard redesign.

options.title: Defer both feature directions
options.body: Land only correctness work and leave sharing and redesign pending a later product cycle.

recommendation.title: Approve the information architecture first
recommendation.body: Confirm the scalable dashboard and fixed share-artifact boundary, then rebase and review the draft redesign before expanding sharing.

likelyOwner.reason: This requires repository-level product sequencing rather than a mechanical code repair.
